title: Tell An AI Your Vibe, Get A Merch Store
desc: Tell the DIGITVL Stores AI your vibe and it drafts your merch store. Nothing goes live until you confirm your prices.

sentences.text: Tell an AI your vibe, and it builds your merch store.
Describe your brand in plain words. Dark, minimal, red and black.
It can fill in your brand details as you talk.
It picks real products, matches colors that exist in the catalog, and drafts the whole store.
Then it stops. Nothing goes live until you confirm your prices.
You stay the boss. The AI just does the busywork.
Prices are suggested above a safe floor, and the final call is yours.

chat.user: Dark, minimal, red and black. Hoodies and tees.
chat.ai: Got it. I'm drafting your store now.
